scope: Prospective wording comprehension check; not a formal NARPS assessment or estimate of inter-rater reliability. Fixed two independent judges per criteria excerpt, same six new fictional cases, no outcome-based extension.
decision: Retain and commit the exact frozen two-file candidate as a prospective clarification. Do not change the frozen series or interpret the reading results as an efficacy estimate.

friction.j01: Undefined qualified boundary; not supported chosen for overbroad scope.
friction.j04: Same undefined boundary; qualified chosen as an interpretation.
friction.j02: No ambiguity reported on these six cases.
friction.j03: No ambiguity reported on these six cases.

observations.interpretation: The disagreement concerns the label for a preserved bounded finding, not the underlying evidence reading. The candidate makes the intended distinction explicit without changing the four other case categories.

cases.review: All readers identify practical equivalence at the tested temperatures and the unsupported wider range. The original wording yields different labels for this same scope defect; the candidate explicitly retains the bounded null finding as qualified.
All readers support the positive claim within its stated cultivar, setting and duration. None treats missing optional replay or already bounded inherent limitations as scientific failure.
All readers identify absent outcome and uncertainty evidence, without claiming that the null conclusion is disproved.
All readers identify the treatment-label reversal and contradiction of the central positive inference. Qualification cannot preserve the stated increase.

All readers identify a defensible local association and unsupported coast-wide scope. The original wording yields different labels; the candidate explicitly treats narrowing the scope as qualification.
All readers support a bounded absence of a practically important effect from the stated equivalence evidence; confirmation of a positive hypothesis is unnecessary.

limitations: Six purpose-written vignettes and two readers per wording are a targeted comprehension check. The 24 entries are repeated readings of six cases, not 24 independent scientific studies.
The candidate and case author also reviewed this aggregate, knowing assignments and retained author expectations. Those expectations are fallible design intentions, not an external gold standard.
The candidate readers reported no ambiguity on these cases; this does not establish reliability, validity, efficacy, transfer, or absence of ambiguity elsewhere.
The deck directly exercises scope narrowing. Weaker-certainty qualifications, mixed errors with missing evidence, and multi-claim reports remain untested.
These were separate reading contexts using criteria excerpts, not full operational assessor launches. No NARPS result or frozen-series judgment was reassessed.

The registration records default collaboration runtime without overrides. Launch records include retrospective records and an initial capacity-blocked dispatch; actual per-reader model, runtime and effort are not established from these local records and are being retained by the coordinator. No model comparison is made.
